title: Contest Winner Selection Flow
purpose: Document the two winner selection algorithms (standard random and weighted spend) and their shared finalization step
audience: Backend developers, creator experience engineers, QA engineers, platform maintainers
description: When the entry period ends and the creator clicks 'Finalize', the contest service fetches all active entries and checks the winner selection algorithm configured for the contest. Two algorithms exist: standard (uniform random — selects a random index from the entries array using Math.floor(Math.random() * entries.length)) and weighted_spend (queries the transactions table for each entrant's total spend during the contest period, computes tickets as 1 + floor(totalSpend / spendThreshold) * additionalEntries, builds a weighted array, and selects via random index against the weighted array). Both algorithms converge at the finalize step (ContestModel.finalize) which updates the contest record with the winner entry ID. The winner is then announced in the contest UI. Issues: winner selection uses Math.random() (not cryptographically secure), no audit trail records the random seed or algorithm inputs, and the weighted algorithm queries real transaction amounts raising privacy concerns.

preconditions: Entry period has ended (current time > end_date) — or creator manually finalizes early
Contest has at least one eligible entry
Creator has protectAndCreator role and is the contest owner
postconditions: Winner entry ID set on contest record
Winner announced in contest UI via URL params triggering auto-DM
Winner selection result is not recorded in an audit trail

nodes.label: Entry Period Ends — Creator Clicks Finalize
nodes.description: After entry period ends, creator clicks 'Finalize' button on contest management UI. Sends POST /api/v1/contests/:id/finalize.

nodes.label: Validate Finalize Request
nodes.description: protectAndCreator middleware validates creator role and ownership. Controller validates contest exists and is in active state.

nodes.label: ContestEntryModel.findByContestId()
nodes.description: Query all entries for this contest from contest_entries table. Filters for active entries (not withdrawn).

nodes.label: FETCH FROM contest_entries WHERE contest_id
nodes.description: SQL query to retrieve all entry records associated with this contest.

nodes.label: Check Minimum Entries
nodes.description: Verify contest has at least 1 eligible entry. If zero entries, return error.

nodes.label: Check winnerSelection Algorithm
nodes.description: Examine contest.winnerSelection field to determine which algorithm to use.

nodes.label: Standard Algorithm: Generate Random Index
nodes.description: Generate randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * entries.length). Simple uniform random selection from entries array.

nodes.label: Standard Algorithm: Select Winner
nodes.description: Select entries[randomIndex] as the winning entry. Each entry has equal probability (1/N).

nodes.label: Weighted Algorithm: Query Spend Per Entrant
nodes.description: For each entrant: call TransactionModel.getTotalSpendByUser(entrant.userId, contestId) to query total USDC spent during contest period.

nodes.label: SELECT FROM transactions WHERE fan_id AND creator_id AND period
nodes.description: SQL query to sum transaction amounts for each entrant within the contest date range.

nodes.label: Weighted Algorithm: Compute Tickets Per Entrant
nodes.description: Compute tickets = 1 + Math.floor(totalSpend / spendThreshold) * additionalEntries. Each entrant gets at least 1 ticket.

nodes.label: Weighted Algorithm: Build Weighted Array
nodes.description: Build an array where each entrant appears 'tickets' times. Array length = sum of all entrants' tickets.

nodes.label: Weighted Algorithm: Generate Random Index
nodes.description: Generate random index against weighted array using Math.floor(Math.random() * weightedArray.length).

nodes.label: Weighted Algorithm: Select Entrant as Winner
nodes.description: Look up which entrant corresponds to the selected index in weighted array. Higher-spending entrants have proportionally more entries.

nodes.label: ContestModel.finalize() — Update Contest Record
nodes.description: Update contest record: set status = 'completed', winner_id = winnerEntryId. Persist finalization in database.

nodes.label: Enrich Winner Details
nodes.description: Fetch winner's username and avatar_url from profiles table for announcement display.

nodes.label: Announce Winner in Contest UI
nodes.description: Winner displayed in contest UI. Auto-DM sent to winner via URL params (frontend-triggered: ?userId=X&text=Y&autoSend=true).

nodes.label: Return Completed Contest Object
nodes.description: Return updated contest object with winner information to frontend.

decisions.condition: Does the contest have at least 1 eligible entry?
decisions.truePath: Proceed to determine winner selection algorithm
decisions.falsePath: Return error — cannot finalize contest with no entries

decisions.truePath: standard: proceed to uniform random selection. weighted_spend: proceed to transaction query and weighted selection.

errorPaths.trigger: No entries exist for the contest
errorPaths.destination: Cannot finalize — error returned to creator
errorPaths.recovery: Creator can either cancel the contest or extend the entry period

errorPaths.trigger: Weighted algorithm transaction query fails for one entrant
errorPaths.destination: That entrant gets 0 spend (base 1 ticket only)
errorPaths.recovery: Error logged; entrant gets minimum tickets; selection continues

errorPaths.destination: Winner selected but not persisted — race condition between selection and storage
errorPaths.recovery: Creator retries finalize; winner selection re-runs (no idempotency)

errorPaths.destination: Winner selection may be predictable — potential manipulation

validationRules: Creator must own the contest (contest.creator_id matches authenticated user)
Contest must be in active state (not already completed, canceled, or in draft)
Contest must have at least 1 entry to finalize
For weighted_spend: spendThreshold and additionalEntries must be configured on contest
Contest cannot be finalized more than once (status check prevents double-finalize)
businessRules: Standard algorithm: uniform random — each entry has equal probability (1/N)
Weighted algorithm: tickets = 1 + floor(totalSpend / spendThreshold) * additionalEntries
Weighted algorithm queries real transaction amounts (cents) — privacy concern
Math.random() used for both algorithms — not cryptographically secure
No audit trail: no record of random seed, algorithm inputs, or selected winner's probability
Winner announcement via auto-DM using URL params (?userId=X&text=Y&autoSend=true)
securityConsiderations: Math.random() is predictable if attacker knows V8's PRNG state — not suitable for fair contest selection
Weighted algorithm exposes real transaction amounts to server-side computation
No audit trail means winner selection cannot be verified after the fact
No idempotency — re-finalizing re-runs winner selection (potentially different winner)
Creator could theoretically re-finalize until desired winner is selected (no lock on finalized state once set)
performanceConsiderations: Standard algorithm: O(1) memory and time — very fast
Weighted algorithm: O(n) where n = total tickets across all entrants. Weighted array can be large (thousands of entries) for high-spending contests
Weighted algorithm makes N individual transaction queries (N = entrants) — potential N+1 pattern
Weighted array building in memory — could be memory-intensive for contests with many high-spending entrants

annotations.label: 🔴 Not Cryptographically Secure
annotations.description: Math.random() used for winner selection. V8's Math.random() is not cryptographically secure and could be predicted.

annotations.label: 🔴 No Audit Trail
annotations.description: No record of random seed, algorithm inputs, or selected winner's probability. Cannot verify fairness.

annotations.label: 🟡 Weighted Algorithm Privacy Concern
annotations.description: Weighted algorithm queries transactions table with real dollar amounts. Entrant spending data exposed in server-side computation.

annotations.label: No idempotency on finalize
annotations.description: Re-finalizing could select a different winner. No lock preventing double-finalize.
